# Adminer

- Project: https://www.adminer.org · source: https://github.com/vrana/adminer (Jakub Vrána)
- **Not bundled:** WEBit downloads the latest release (MySQL edition) on request from GitHub into `data\modules\adminer\index.php`, verified with the SHA-256 digest of the release. It is served only on `127.0.0.1` through the PHP module.
